note: A REPORT IS A ROW HERE, NOT A CONTROLLER. table — where the rows come from. group_by — the column to break them down by. measure — count, sum or average. column — what to sum or average, when the measure is not a count. lookup {table, value, show[]} — turns grouping keys into names, so a report grouped by department_id reads as Finance rather than 3. where {column: [values]} — narrows the rows before grouping. Every report states how many rows it counted, and counts rows it could NOT group separately rather than dropping them. date_column — when set, the report takes the period picker (month / year / financial year / YTD / MTD / custom dates) on that column. Every report takes the Organization Setup filters (through the employees the rows belong to) and exports to Excel or CSV.
